video_title: Kyle Anderson (李凯尔) learns Chinese trash talk, tells stories about young Kawhi with Spurs

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson reflects on his 13-year NBA career and growth
quotes.excerpt: I've been in the league a long time. It's a pretty cool moment to think back
quotes.quote: I've been in the league a long time. It's a pretty cool moment to think back to where I was rookie year to now being in my 13th year. It's crazy. When I used to hear that as a rookie, it didn't make sense to me.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson discusses his preferred jersey number and history
quotes.excerpt: I never got to wear it in the league. I got to wear it one year in Minnesota
quotes.quote: I never got to wear it in the league. I got to wear it one year in Minnesota, number five. That's always been my number.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson on playing with Kawhi Leonard and the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: That whole team was a special group. We won a lot of games. Kawhi is a competitive dude
quotes.quote: That whole team was a special group. We won a lot of games. Kawhi is a competitive dude, he's going to try to beat you at everything, so you're going to try to hold your own for sure.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson on the transition from youngest to oldest player
quotes.excerpt: I think the year before we were the two youngest guys on the team, my first two years
quotes.quote: I think the year before we were the two youngest guys on the team, my first two years, and now I think we're the two oldest guys on the team.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson on when veterans finally learned his name
quotes.excerpt: We had beaten Golden State and Golden State was hot. We went out to dinner after
quotes.quote: We had beaten Golden State and Golden State was hot. We went out to dinner after and Tim ordered me a Jack and Coke and he was like, so rook tell me about yourself, what's your name? It was three or four months into the season. We pounded Jack and Cokes for the rest of the night and me and Timmy got close that night.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson names his all-time starting five of teammates
quotes.excerpt: I got to go Steph at the one, Anthony Edwards at the two, Kawhi at the three
quotes.quote: I got to go Steph at the one, Anthony Edwards at the two, Kawhi at the three, Timmy at the four, and you got to go KAT or Rudy at the five. Or you could go LaMarcus Aldridge at the five.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson explains his Chinese heritage and family history
quotes.excerpt: My mother's grandfather was born in China. He moved to Jamaica in the early 1900s
quotes.quote: My mother's grandfather was born in China. He moved to Jamaica in the early 1900s and started a family in Jamaica. He left his family in China, started another family in Jamaica, and had 13 children in Jamaica. My grandmother was the last of the 13.

quotes.speaker: Kyle Anderson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Anderson and Lindsay Dunn practice Chinese trash talk
quotes.excerpt: Ni tai man le, which means you're too slow.

text_blocks.speaker: Kyle Anderson
text_blocks.text: It's ni tai man le, which means you're too slow.

text_blocks.speaker: Kyle Anderson
text_blocks.text: Ni fang bu zhu wo, which means you can't guard me.

text_blocks.speaker: Kyle Anderson
text_blocks.text: Ni de nu peng you zai kan wo.
